title: Grundgesetztotem
description: Das deutsche Totem of Undying — replaces the vanilla Totem of Undying with the German Grundgesetz (constitution) book. Comes with a custom texture and a tailored item model for clean rendering in hand and inventory.
body: Replaces the Totem of Undying with the German Grundgesetz (constitution) book. Comes with a custom texture and a tailored item model, so the book displays cleanly both in your inventory and while holding it in either hand, whether in first-person or third-person view. A small, self-contained resource pack made for players who want a bit of German civic pride mixed into their survival world.
